sections.title: Site and work
sections.note: Recorded approval is not a digital signature. Confirm quantities with the client before invoicing.
sections.sql: select name,project,work_date,description from docket_register where id=$1

sections.title: Resources and quantities
sections.sql: select worker,plant,hours,quantity,unit from docket_register where id=$1

name: site-brief
title: Site allocation and safety brief
for_each: select id,name from projects where status='active'

sections.title: Allocations
sections.sql: select name,work_date,worker,plant,hours from allocation_checks where project_id=$1 order by work_date

sections.title: Checks to resolve
sections.sql: select c.record,c.work_date,c.rule,c.issue from compliance_findings c join projects p on p.name=c.project where p.id=$1 order by work_date

sections.title: Site diary
sections.sql: select work_date,notes from diary where project_id=$1 order by work_date desc
